title: Waiver Basis by Booking: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In Rental Waiver
content:
**Tariff ruling on the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental rental waiver basis.** The waiver amount is figured on a basis that depends on the booking:

1. a contract booked to come back on its scheduled pickup date takes the lower of the first-day rental fee as posted and **0.5** of the class base rate, so that a part-day rental is waived as part of a day;
2. a longer booking whose scheduled pickup date is a Friday, Saturday or Sunday takes the lower of the first-day rental fee as posted and the class base rate, so that any pickup-day surcharge in its first-day fee stays payable;
3. any other booking takes the first-day rental fee as posted.

A booking that comes back on its scheduled pickup date falls under item 1 whatever the weekday.

## Cases (hypothetical Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck contracts; class base rate 29.95)

| Booking | First-day rental fee as posted | Waiver basis |
|---|---|---|
| Pickup and return both scheduled on a Tuesday | 29.95 | 14.975 — the lower of 29.95 and 0.5 of 29.95 |
| Pickup and return both scheduled on a Saturday | 35.94 | 14.975 — item 1 applies |
| Pickup scheduled Saturday, return Monday | 35.94 | 29.95 — the lower of 35.94 and 29.95 |
| Pickup scheduled Friday, return Saturday | 26.96 | 26.96 — the lower of 26.96 and 29.95 |
| Pickup scheduled Tuesday, return Thursday | 32.95 | 32.95 — as posted |

Figures in this table are not rounded on their own; rounding to the cent comes once, on the rental waiver finally credited.
